groups.label: Identity and current state
groups.description: Canonical identity, organization boundary, lifecycle, reference target, asset class, issuance, and date semantics.

dimensions.label: Organizations and roles
dimensions.description: Recorded organization relationships remain separate from the asset itself.

dimensions.label: Lifecycle
dimensions.description: Recorded lifecycle state, separate from issuance and market access.

dimensions.label: Launch date
dimensions.description: Historical launch date and explicit unresolved tracking remain distinct.

groups.label: Mechanism, reserves, and redemption
groups.description: Backing structure, stabilization, reserve disclosure, report dates, and redemption terms are compared as separate facts.

dimensions.label: Backing model
dimensions.description: Canonical backing types and reserve-component records.

dimensions.label: Stabilization and governance
dimensions.description: Recorded stabilization mechanism and governance model.

dimensions.label: Reserve disclosure
dimensions.description: Disclosure profile and canonical reserve-record coverage.

dimensions.label: Reserve reports
dimensions.description: Report count and latest canonical report date semantics.

dimensions.label: Redemption
dimensions.description: Eligibility, settlement, limits, fees, restrictions, and review context.

groups.label: Legal, regulatory, and access context
groups.description: Jurisdiction-scoped legal classifications, regulatory notes, and canonical Market Access Records remain bounded to their source scope.

dimensions.label: Legal classification
dimensions.description: Jurisdiction-scoped classifications and structural holder/reserve fields.

dimensions.label: Regulatory notes
dimensions.description: Canonical regulatory-note records; absence is not proof that no action exists.

dimensions.label: Market access
dimensions.description: Canonical provider- and function-scoped access records only.

groups.label: Evidence and uncertainty
groups.description: Unknown states, evidence scope, and unresolved questions are shown rather than converted into scores.

dimensions.label: Protected unknown state
dimensions.description: Whether unresolved state remains visible and how many canonical known-unknown rows are linked.

dimensions.label: Evidence scope
dimensions.description: Canonical evidence count and claim-scope categories.

dimensions.label: Known unknowns
dimensions.description: Count, topics, and severity distribution of explicit unresolved questions.
